title: Iranian Revolution
summary: A year of strikes, demonstrations and funerals brought down the Pahlavi monarchy: the Shah left Iran in January 1979, Khomeini returned in February, and a referendum in April established an Islamic republic whose constitution put a jurist above the elected government. It was a revolution made in the cities by a coalition of clergy, bazaar, left and liberals, and then closed by one part of it against the others. Its immediate effect on the rest of the world was economic — Iranian output collapsed and the oil price doubled again in 1979, which is the second shock that runs through every European economy of the early 1980s.
